scene_title: Artisanal Japanese Culinary Ceremonial M - Initiation
hazard_description: High-acceleration robotic motion-control arm sweep and track pinch-point envelope.
engineering_controls: SIL-3 hardware E-stop lanyard at Video Village & Rig Base; Optical LiDAR/laser perimeter safety curtain interlock; Dry-run kinematic envelope sweep at 25% velocity prior to talent entry
ppe_required: Steel-toe stage footwear; ANSI Z87.1 impact eyewear; High-visibility floor spotter vest
notes: CSATF Bulletin #40 (Robotic Camera & Motion Control Safety).

scene_title: Artisanal Japanese Culinary Ceremonial M - Initiation
hazard_description: Tabletop thermal cooking surfaces, boiling/searing liquids, sharp cutlery, and food allergen controls.
engineering_controls: Class K wet-chemical & ABC fire extinguishers staged within 3.0m; Heat-resistant silicone surface mats & insulated induction zones; Dedicated allergen-free prep trays & food-safe temperature log
ppe_required: Cut-resistant Kevlar food-styling glove (prep); Heat-insulated nitrile/silicone mitts; Closed-toe non-slip kitchen footwear
notes: CSATF Bulletin #16 (Open Flame / Thermal) & studio food-safety allergen SOP.

scene_title: Artisanal Japanese Culinary Ceremonial M - Initiation
hazard_description: High-draw DMX/HMI lighting distribution near wet set surfaces, condensation, or metallic truss.
engineering_controls: Class-A 5mA GFCI inline protection on all wet-area distribution drops; Elevated cable ramps, rubber matting, and bonded stage ground; IP65 weather-sealed DMX splitters & ballast isolation stands
ppe_required: EH-rated insulated rubber-sole footwear; Insulated electrical handling gloves (Gaffer crew)
notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (General Safety) & CSATF Bulletin #22 (Electrical / Wet Location Safety).
